## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The legacy fetcher must stop after three attempts to comply with the existing retry policy and limit worker occupancy during outages.

## Changes
The pull request adds inventory fetch and health helpers, retry tests, and a documented legacy exemption. This review read the tests without running them.

## Critical
- app/legacy/fetch.py:7 — correctness — Cap legacy inventory retries at three attempts — When the legacy service stays unavailable, your fetcher makes eight attempts instead of stopping at three. The pre-change policy requires: “Code that retries a network call must stop after at most 3 attempts.” (`docs/review-rules.md:5`). — During an inventory outage, eight ten-second connection timeouts and seven retry delays can occupy a worker for roughly 87 seconds.
